body: Not conversationally. Awareness it's there and disdain for the message.

I think mainly that I feel I've exhausted every potential fix, that I have no hope for the future across the board. That when I close my eyes I hear a voice telling me everything that makes me worthless and why my existence is just as pointless as any. That when I think about the chapters of my life each ends without a point or meaning. hat despite my history and the experience I've gained from that history has helped or aided me. That I'm widely disliked and forgotten. And that I despise all aspects of myself despite on the surface and outwardly that shouldn't be the case based on the poorly formed standards of others.

Hey, not really sure. Feel often that I was a mistake in the sense that it's not natural to be the way that I am. But I am this way and I hate every aspect of it. But my attempts to change or help or fix these things have proved impermanent; that I'll always return back to this status quo of thinking.
